subject: Mutual action plan: security acceptance checklist & final-mile timeline
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finledger.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aisha.patel@finledger.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP & security gates

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to lock down the remaining items that will unblock procurement: SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ mapping, and a finalized DPA that includes our 7-year archival requirement. Procurement asked for a compact mutual action plan (MAP) that scopes security gates and a hard close target the week of July 29.

Can you confirm what artifacts we can produce in the next two weeks and who owns each item on your side? Also — we have an internal data-retention policy that requires a 7-year archive for transaction logs; we need confirmation whether Redwood Private or Dedicated meets that or whether an export/escrow clause is required in the DPA.

High-level asks from our side: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (full PDF or SOC2 bridge)
- SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet marked with control responses and evidence pointers
- DPA with retention section and redline response
- A named point of contact for evidence intake and a handoff date

If you can propose a short MAP with owners and dates by EOD Tuesday (7/17), we can review and share with procurement.

Best,
Tom
Director of Security Operations
FinLedger
From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finledger.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security acceptance checklist & final-mile timeline

Tom — thanks for the clear list. Putting a compact MAP below that aligns artifacts to owners and dates. We believe the week-of-29 target is achievable if we keep parallel tracks (evidence intake + legal DPA).

Proposed MAP (milestones & owners):
1) Evidence intake: SOC 2 report + SIG matrix (owner: Marissa Cole) — draft evidence folder delivered to FinLedger Drive link by 2028-07-19 EOD.
   - Deliverables: SOC2-Type2-Report-2027.pdf (or bridge), SIG-CAIQ-matrix-FinLedger.xlsx with inline references to attachments.
2) DPA redline: (owner: Karthik Iyer, Legal) — initial redline sent to FinLedger by 2028-07-18. FinLedger to return comments by 2028-07-20.
3) Retention decision & export path: (owner: Product & Legal — Jasmine / Karthik) — confirm whether Dedicated/Private meets 7-year archival or whether escrow/export clause is needed by 2028-07-20.
4) Final acceptance checkpoint: (owner: Tom & Marissa) — joint review session the morning of 2028-07-25; signoff to enable procurement close week of 2028-07-29.

Quick notes on retention: Redwood Dedicated and Private can be configured for regionally-contained storage, and we support configurable retention policies at the customer bucket level. For 7-year immutable archival we recommend an export-and-escrow clause in the DPA as a fast path; if you want an on-platform immutable tier we’ll engage infra but that adds ~3-4 week lead time. We’ll confirm in Karthik's redline.

Attachments I will circulate today: MPAsprint checklist + evidence manifest. Marissa will upload the SIG mapping to the Drive folder for your review.

Would you prefer a 30-minute sync on Thursday 7/19 to walk the checklist? If so, propose times and we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finledger.com>, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jul 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security acceptance checklist & final-mile timeline

Tom — quick legal note from my side. Ive attached a clean DPA redline (DPA-redline-FinLedger.docx stub). High-level positions: 
- We can accept an export-and-escrow clause for immutable archival; I will add language documenting the export format, handoff SLA (7 business days), and verification procedure.
- For Dedicated-hosted use: we commit to data residency and commercial SSAE/SOC controls, but platform-level immutable retention typically requires an addendum.
- We are okay with a 7-year retention term provided the DPA includes scope and cost responsibility for escrow storage.

I will incorporate the retention appendix into the redline and send a second pass by 2028-07-18 EOD. If FinLedger prefers we can convert the escrow option into a clause that allows you to request a Redwood-executed export in the event of termination.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finledger.com>, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security acceptance checklist & final-mile timeline — evidence handoff

Tom / Team — thanks for the sync earlier today. Following up with the finalized evidence bundle and a short checklist so procurement has everything they asked for.

Delivered artifacts (Drive folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFINLEDGER-MPA):
- SOC2-Type2-Report-2027.pdf (stub)
- SIG-CAIQ-matrix-FinLedger.xlsx (stub) with per-control evidence pointers (logs, configuration screenshots, policy docs)
- MPA-final-sprint-checklist.md (stub) — MAP with owners and dates (mirrors items below)
- DPA-redline-FinLedger.docx (stub) — Karthik's retention appendix included

Acceptance checklist (final-mile):
- [ ] FinLedger legal confirms DPA redline by 2028-07-24 EOD
- [ ] FinLedger security acknowledges SOC2 evidence and SIG mapping by 2028-07-24 EOD
- [ ] Joint review call to resolve open items scheduled for 2028-07-25 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent)
- [ ] Procurement signoff targeted 2028-07-29

If the retention appendix needs to convert to an escrow-only flow, please flag that in your DPA comments. Otherwise, well treat export-and-escrow as the default fast path and will provide an estimated cost for storage and retrieval in the DPA redline.

Thanks — were inline to hit your week-of-29 target.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
